name: clearstack-data-mcp
description: ATS jobs, Google Ads, Telegram OSINT, EU KYB/sanctions & public tenders for AI assistants, via Apify.
long_description: Ask Claude which companies are hiring with salary & tech stack filters, what Google Ads a competitor runs (with optional EU DSA impressions), what public Telegram channels posted (with OSINT/crypto extraction), whether an EU company passes VAT & OFAC/EU/UN sanctions checks, or which European public tenders and contract awards were published. Each tool runs a ClearStack Data Actor on Apify with your own Apify API token and an automatic spending cap.

tools.name: search_ats_jobs
tools.description: Open roles from company career sites on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters (25,787 employers).

tools.name: search_google_ads
tools.description: Ads a company runs on Google, from the public Google Ads Transparency Center.

tools.name: get_telegram_channel_posts
tools.description: Recent posts from public Telegram channels, no Telegram account needed.

tools.name: verify_eu_company
tools.description: EU VAT validation (VIES), official company registry record, and live OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening.

tools.name: search_eu_tenders
tools.description: European public procurement notices and contract awards from EU TED, France BOAMP, and UK Find a Tender.

tools.name: get_run_results
tools.description: Finish a search whose Apify run was still going.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your Apify API token, from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Calls are billed to this Apify account.
